abstract: Large language models increasingly write the code behind empirical research. This column reports a benchmark of 40 econometric tasks in Stata, R, and Python. For each task, two leading models write a script, as a chatbot that never runs it and as an agent that runs and revises it. Letting the models run their code raises the share of correct results from 79% to 97% and makes the prompt and the software matter far less. The failures that remain under the agent come from scripts that run without errors but return wrong numbers, and detecting them is still the researcher’s work.
authors: Sebastian Galiani, Federico A. López, Raul A. Sosa
title: Letting AI agents write econometric code
